Asian Markets Mixed as Investors Monitor Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Prices

Asian markets experienced mixed trading, with some indices showing gains while others weakened. Investors were closely monitoring geopolitical escalations in the Middle East, specifically involving Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces, which contributed to a rise in oil prices. In contrast, U.S. stock futures showed a slight increase, following gains on Wall Street where oil prices had previously retreated from recent highs. Markets in mainland China were closed for a holiday.
